chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'I do not like for a Muslim man to marry a co-wife who was previously married to his mother by someone other than his father.'

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.ضَرَّة: Co-wife (a woman sharing the same husband)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man marrying his stepmother's co-wife in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies that it is disliked (makruh) for a man to marry the co-wife of his stepmother, provided she was married to a different husband than his father. This ruling extends the scope of marital prohibitions beyond direct lineage to include affinities formed through marriage, reflecting the juristic principle of preventing familial confusion and maintaining social harmony within the extended family structure.
